现在完成进行时:have been doing: 强调动作从过去持续到现在、而且"还在进行"或"刚刚停下",常和 for / all day 搭配。
结构:have / has been + 动词-ing|强调动作的持续性,常带 for two hours、all morning|回答 What have you been doing?|短暂动词( arrive、find )一般不用进行时|与现在完成时对比:I have read it(读完了)vs I have been reading it(还在读)
It has been raining all morning.
She has been learning English for six years.
You look tired. Have you been running?
column3: 你看起来很累,刚才跑步了?

现在完成进行时:have been doing: I have been writing the report since 9 a.m.
column3: 我从早上九点起一直在写报告。

现在完成进行时:have been doing: They have been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes.
column3: 他们等公交已经二十分钟了。

# title: I ___ for the exam all week.
column4: all week 强调持续复习,用完成进行时。
读完三本强调结果,用现在完成时。

# title: How long ___ you been living here?
column4: 句中已有 been,疑问词组 How long have you been doing。

# title: It ___ since last night; the streets are wet.
column4: 从昨晚持续下到现在,街道湿了。

# title: They ___ the door; that's why they are out of breath.
column4: 刚停下、气喘吁吁,用 have been painting。

# title: He ___ his phone. Look, he is holding it.
column4: find 是短暂动词,表结果用 has found。
